Global Engagement and Partnerships About us Global Engagement and Partnerships At Royal Holloway, we believe in fostering meaningful international partnerships. Our commitment to international collaboration is at the heart of our mission to cultivate a global community of scholars, innovators, and leaders. Through our comprehensive International Strategy, we strive to create opportunities for cross-cultural exchange, research collaboration, and educational partnerships that enrich the academic experience for our students and staff. Whether it's forging connections with leading institutions around the world or engaging in impactful research initiatives, Royal Holloway, University of London is dedicated to making a difference on a global scale. Our current portfolio of partner universities is diverse and spans across various countries. We are proud to collaborate with prestigious institutions such as the University of California, the University of Toronto, Yale University, and Korea University as our exchange partners, Communications University and Minzu University in China for our Double Degree programmes, and the University of London for the distance learning programmes. We are also proud to work with Study Group as our strategic recruitment partner. Please follow the links below to find out more about our partnerships. We are looking to partner with like-minded institutions and organisations around the world, who are supportive of our values of equality and social justice and share our commitment to transform lives through education. Royal Holloway's web page for its approved agents. To help you advise students and find key information quickly, we’ve put together a list of useful links. Contact Us If you can’t find what you’re looking for, contact the Regional Manager covering your country. You can find their details on our Meet the team page. On our Find your country/region pages you’ll also find info on your fellow agents and the qualifications we accept from your country. For agency queries, for example commission, appointment, renewals or relating to CRM Recruit, please contact agents@royalholloway.ac.uk Applying Applying to undergraduate and postgraduate courses (including step-by-step guide to online application for postgraduates) How to track an undergraduate application How to track a postgraduate application What happens after you apply (undergraduates and postgraduates) Accommodation for undergraduates and postgraduates Applying for Halls accommodation If you are an education agent residing outside the United Kingdom, EU, EEA, Switzerland, United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand, please submit applications for undergraduate and postgraduate degrees and courses via our trusted partner, Study Group. Visit the agent portal Your Agent Portal For training on using CRM Recruit you can register for our online webinar here . For education agents and counsellors residing outside the United Kingdom, EU, EEA, Switzerland, United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand visit the agent portal hosted via our trusted partner Study Group Tuition Fees and Scholarships Tuition fees for undergraduate students Tuition fees for postgraduate students Scholarships for undergraduate and postgraduate students How to pay the tuition fees For international students who have applied via an agent through our trusted partner Study Group, deposit payment should be made via the Study Group portal. For details of how to pay, please refer to offer letters or email studentpayments@studygroup.com for help. English Language Requirements English language requirements and university preparation programmes (international foundation, pre-masters and pre-sessional English language programmes ). Student Life On and around the campus Experience a virtual tour Social life, sport and other activities Support and wellbeing Visas and Immigration Information on visas (applying for/renewing a visa, family visas, and restrictions on working etc) you can also contact our International Student Support office at internationaladvice@rhul.ac.uk . Pathway Programmes We offer a range of pathway programmes for students who may not meet the requirements for direct entry. We currently offer an International Foundation Year, International Year One and Pre-Masters programme. All our pathways are taught by Study Group at our Egham campus International Study Centre. Videos and Resources Experience a virtual tour Find out about postgraduate study Clubs and societies Explore the local area Tour of two of our accommodation halls, George Eliot and Founder's Contracted agents For our contracted education agents, please get in touch with our trusted partner, Study Group. For all other agents residing in the United Kingdom, EU, EEA, Switzerland, United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand, please find a list of our current partners here . UK Agent Quality Framework At Royal Holloway we are dedicated to providing students with the best resources and guidance for their educational journey. We understand that navigating the process of studying abroad can be challenging, and we are here to support you every step of the way. As a signatory of the UK Agent Quality Framework, Royal Holloway follows its standards and best practices. We are committed to working closely with agents to ensure they adhere to ethical standards and empower student choice. Job Opportunities Our current job opportunities are grouped together into categories below. Select your preferred sort order to see the vacancies in which you are interested.
